name: Golden Destiny
body:
Gain a bonus to bribe fate and an extra use of this trait per day.

Prerequisite: Numistian, Wis 15, Character Level 7.

Benefit: After activating your bribe fate racial trait, gain your Wisdom modifier as a racial bonus to your second savings throw. In addition, you gain an additional use of bribe fate for the day. This feat can only be taken once.

Remarkable Races: Compendium of Unusual PC Races, Pathway to Adventure Edition. Copyright 2009, Alluria Publishing; Author: J. Matthew Kubisz
